challenge.results: The case rule is part of the general lexical paragraph and precedes the specific rules on identifiers and reserved words. The examples give consistent evidence and reveal no conflicting case treatment for this scoped claim.

limitations: The finding covers lexical letter distinctions in the cited revision. Unicode case mapping, collation, and the rules of other editions remain outside its scope.
